latest_post.summary: 日経記事を共有し、東邦チタニウム社長が航空機需要は旺盛でもチタン在庫調整に時間がかかるとの発言を伝えている。本人の見通しはなく、同社は2026年5月上場廃止済み。
latest_post.summary_en: Sharing a Nikkei article, the post conveys comments by the president of Toho Titanium stating that while aircraft demand is strong, titanium inventory adjustments will take time; there is no personal outlook, and the company was delisted in May 2026.
